text: Entry Requirements Non-Chinese citizens who are at least 18 years of age (up to and including 31 December of the year of application for offline entry in the autumn semester and up to and including 31 August of the following year for online entry in the autumn semester), with a high school diploma or above and in good health. Applicants to the Pre-Economic Management Program (entry in September each year) must have HSK3 or above or appropriate Chinese language proficiency. Applicants for the spring session (entry in March each year) must have HSK4 or above or appropriate Chinese language proficiency. Those who are under 18 years of age by 31 August of the year of application must provide information on their guardian.
